note: Trigger-routing suite for the pilot (GitHub issue #39). Negatives are near-misses owned by write-handoff (return-block format), the artifact-bound *-reviewer/*-auditor agents' own rubrics (component/layout/doc-specific dimensions), check-all-agents/check-all-skills (DEEP portfolio scoring), and fleet-rules/doc-writing-rules (unrelated design/document work a reviewer conversation could drift toward).
